headline: 80% of developers find AI coding more addictive than helpful
angle: Developers have replaced one dependency with another, just with better marketing.
scene: A software developer slouched in a chair, one hand reaching toward a glowing laptop screen like an addict. Empty energy drink cans and coffee cups pile up on the desk. Behind them, a framed photo of their family is turned face-down. The laptop screen glows with an AI assistant's cheerful interface.
setup: "At least when I was addicted to caffeine, nobody called it innovation."
instagram_caption: turns out trading one dependency for another is still just trading one dependency for another.
